annotations.title: Recommend paid APIs for a task

description: Find which paid x402 API to call for a task described in plain words, ranked with evidence. Each pick has the endpoint URL, provider price and payment network, a ready request template, liveness, delivery evidence and risk flags. Use it when you do not yet know which API to call; use inspect instead when you already have one exact endpoint URL, and receipt to confirm settlement after paying. Write need as the task itself ("current weather in Paris"), not a product name; narrow with max_price_usd or chain, and use view=compact to save tokens. Free demo: need exactly "weather", "crypto prices" or "web search" (any case); every other need, including longer weather phrasings, costs 0.01 USDC. Pays only if the wallet owner set AGENTS_TRUST_ENABLE_PAYMENTS=true and AGENTS_TRUST_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY (Base USDC): one paid call per process, at most AGENTS_TRUST_MAX_CALL_USDC (default 0.01), never retried. Otherwise it errors without paying; errors and empty results are free. Returns JSON {data, payment_attempt_id, request_id}; payment_attempt_id is set only after a paid answer, for use with receipt. data.picks may be shorter than limit, or empty, when evidence is insufficient.

chain.description: Only return providers that accept payment on this network, as a CAIP-2 id, e.g. eip155:8453 for Base.

live.description: Only 1 is accepted, which is also the default: prefer endpoints with recent liveness evidence.

max_price_usd.description: Highest provider price per call in USD you accept. Separate from the 0.01 USDC recommendation fee; the provider's own quote at call time is authoritative.

need.description: The work you need done, in plain words, e.g. "weather forecast for Berlin" or "translate text to German". 2–300 characters with at least two letters or digits.

view.description: Response detail: compact (smallest, pick essentials and request template), evidence (adds ranking, liveness, delivery and payment evidence per pick) or legacy (default, original field layout).
